mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_product(product_key, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{productKey}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_key, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at FROM iot_product ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE iot_product SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_key = #{productKey}
UPDATE iot_product SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_key = #{productKey}
